comparisonWithPreTask6.geoid: APPLIES. Roof polygons coincide with their aerial-imagery footprints to a pixel or two. At this camera a 37 m vertical error (Yokohama's EGM2008 undulation) would displace a roof about 37·cos(65°) ≈ 16 m ≈ 9 px against its own footprint; nothing of the sort is visible, and the inspector's picked building reads height 36.7 m with a cell-frame z range 0.0–38.5 m.
